Handheld Weather Station — Gust & Gloom

A pocket weather station that is polite about humidity and extremely suspicious of umbrellas.

Description

Gust & Gloom is a compact, handheld weather station that fits in your pocket but provides professional-grade meteorological data. This elegantly designed device combines multiple sensors with a beautiful OLED display and companion mobile app to deliver comprehensive weather information wherever you go.

Perfect for:

  • Hikers and outdoor enthusiasts
  • Farmers and gardeners
  • Meteorologists and weather enthusiasts
  • Educators and students
  • Emergency preparedness

Key Features

Sensors

  • Temperature: -40°C to 85°C with 0.1°C resolution
  • Humidity: 0-100% RH with 0.1% resolution
  • Barometric Pressure: 300-1100 hPa with 0.1 hPa resolution
  • Wind Speed: 0-50 m/s with 0.1 m/s resolution
  • Wind Direction: 360° with 1° resolution
  • Rain Gauge: 0-999 mm with 0.2 mm resolution

Display & Interface

  • OLED Screen: 128x64 pixel display with clear readings
  • Touch Controls: Intuitive capacitive buttons
  • Backlight: Automatic or manual control
  • Units: Switch between metric and imperial
  • Languages: Multiple language support

Data & Connectivity

  • Internal Storage: 30 days of 1-minute interval data
  • Bluetooth: Real-time data streaming to mobile devices
  • USB: Data export and firmware updates
  • Battery: 1000mAh LiPo with 30+ days runtime

What’s Included

  • Sensor board with integrated microcontroller
  • 3D-printed enclosure with weather-resistant design
  • USB charging cable
  • Quick start guide
  • Calibration certificate

Mobile App

Features

  • Real-time Display: Live sensor readings
  • Historical Data: Graphs and trends

Usage

Basic Operation

  1. Power On: Hold the power button for 2 seconds
  2. View Readings: Current conditions display automatically
  3. Navigate: Use touch buttons to view different sensors
  4. Connect: Pair with mobile app via Bluetooth

Data Collection

  • Automatic Logging: Records data every minute
  • Manual Readings: Take spot measurements anytime
  • Sync: Automatically syncs with mobile app when in range

Maintenance

  • Calibration: Annual calibration recommended
  • Cleaning: Keep sensors free of debris
  • Battery: Charge every 30 days when not in use
  • Storage: Store in cool, dry place

Technical Details

Accuracy

  • Temperature: ±0.5°C
  • Humidity: ±3% RH
  • Pressure: ±1 hPa
  • Wind Speed: ±0.5 m/s
  • Wind Direction: ±5°
  • Rain: ±0.2 mm

Power Management

  • Sleep mode when not in use
  • Solar charging option available
  • Low-power microcontroller design
  • Efficient sensor polling algorithms

Integration

APIs

  • REST API: Access data programmatically
  • Webhook Support: Real-time data delivery
  • MQTT: IoT platform integration
  • Weather Services: Submit data to weather networks

Compatible Platforms

  • Home Assistant: Native integration
  • InfluxDB/Grafana: Data visualization
  • Weather Underground: Data submission
  • Custom Applications: Full API access
